33:51.text: , and you may receive whom you will. And whomsoever you desire of those whom you have set aside
, it is no sin on you
: that is better that they may be comforted and not grieved, and may all be pleased with what you give them. Allâh knows what is in your hearts. And Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

33:52.text: It is not lawful for you
women after this, nor to change them for other wives even though their beauty attracts you, except those
whom your right hand possesses. And Allâh is Ever a Watcher over all things.

33:53.text: O you who believe! Enter not the Prophet’s houses, unless permission is given to you for a meal,
to wait for its preparation. But when you are invited, enter, and when you have taken your meal, disperse without sitting for a talk. Verily, such
annoys the Prophet, and he is shy of
; but Allâh is not shy of
the truth. And when you ask
for anything you want, ask them from behind a screen: that is purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not
for you that you should annoy Allâh’s Messenger, nor that you should ever marry his wives after him
. Verily, with Allâh that shall be an enormity.

33:54.text: Whether you reveal anything or conceal it, verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knower of everything.
